caption:
The crawlspace was starting to shrink, but this staff room feels like a victory. Smells like industrial soap and old coffee. I’ve traded my clothes for coveralls and a heavy tool bag—blending in is surprisingly easy when you just look like you're supposed to be there. It’s a relief to finally stand up straight. 

She walks into the main corridor while the radio in the room she just left continues to broadcast her identity. 🎧🕵️‍♀️

#NeoTokyo #Archive #HideInPlainSight #Ghosting #IndustrialAesthetic #2097 #Survival
